title: ci(scripts): read the shard sizes from ci.yml's matrix blocks instead of copying them
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9MKqYfea9FwGdabNwe4CdFw)_
Part of #26443
Part of #26431

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增一个读取器 `scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs`，从 ci.yml 的 `matrix:` 读分片数；分片器、必需上下文自测、分片证明自测三处不再自抄 /8、/3。
- 为什么改：以前改一次矩阵大小要找遍几处副本，副本都不是权威；现在数字只写在工作流里。
- 风险与回滚：只动仓内 CI 脚本和根 package.json 一个别名；读取器读不到矩阵就报错，不回落默认值。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs`（读取与拒收规则）、`scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` 的 `SHARD_COUNT` 一行、`scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs` 自测里改成派生的锚点。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs` 应打印 `test 8 planned` / `dogfood 3 literal` / `test-ui 16 literal` 三行。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **New `scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs`**, the one reader of ci.yml's shard-matrix sizes. It reads a job's `strategy.matrix.shard` as text (no `yaml` dependency, because `check-shard-attestation.mjs` runs in jobs that install none and `partition-test-shards.mjs` needs the count synchronously at import). It understands the two spellings ci.yml uses: a literal list `[1, 2, 3]`, and a planned matrix `fromJSON(... || 'FALLBACK')`, whose size is the full-roster fallback. Every other shape is refused with an error naming the job: no such job, no `matrix:`, no `shard:`, two `matrix:` blocks, a planned matrix with no fallback, a block sequence, a scalar, quoted items, or a list that is not exactly 1..N. There is no default count.
- **`scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs`**: `SHARD_COUNT` is now `liveShardTotal('test')` instead of the literal `8`. Self-test step 4 no longer compares the matrix with a copy of itself; it still reads back the two other ci.yml spellings (`--shard N/M` and the attestation's `--total`).
- **`scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`**: battery (9)'s shadowing-collision anchor `name: Test Core (… matrix.shard …/N)` is built from the live matrix size. Two header lines that still said `/3` now say `/N`.
- **`scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs`**: every self-test anchor taken from the live ci.yml derives its size from the reader. That covers the live display names of both matrices, the `TEST_MATRIX`/`GATE_PLAN` fallback rosters, the `--leg "test/N:` roster anchor, the literal-list control and the `TEST_NAME`/dogfood-name anchors. It also adds one assertion that the live test matrix reads as the planned shape those #26084 anchors assume (325 → 326 assertions).
- **`package.json`**: `check:shard-attestation` runs `node scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs --self-test` first. lint.yml already runs that alias, so the reader's self-test runs in CI and `check:self-test-wired` counts it (239 → 240 scripts) without a workflow edit.

## Why

The shard sizes were spelled in five self-tests and fixtures, and no copy was the authority. ci.yml's `matrix:` blocks are. Resizing a matrix meant editing every copy (#26443 Measured). This PR does the devx half. The ui half (two `/16` fixtures under `ui/scripts/__tests__/`) and `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs` (the #26431 roster child) are left for their own cards, so neither card closes here.

## Tests

- `node scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs --self-test`: `✓ ci-shard-matrix self-test: 27 cases pass across 5 batteries (live: test=8, dogfood=3, test-ui=16).` The batteries are the live ci.yml (4), the literal list (3), the planned matrix (3), job boundaries (3) and refusals with no default (14). The refusal battery includes a checkout with no ci.yml (`ENOENT`, not defaulted). It uses the battery-name floor and the verdict handshake copied from `check-agent-model-declared.mjs`.
- `node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test`: `self-test OK (75 measured packages -> 78 shard items, 8 shards, …)`, exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs --self-test`: `174 assertions`, exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs --self-test`: `326 assertions`, exit 0.
- `node scripts/ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs --self-test` (imports `SHARD_COUNT`): exit 0.

## Verification

Gate families from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at head `35440f1d`: 44 derived, and all 44 ran locally with exit 0. They include `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (`✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1935 cases pass`), `check:self-test-wired`, `check:required-contexts`, `check:shard-attestation`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, and the four dist readers after a `./packages/**` build under the verify lock. `--ran` reconciliation: `44 derived, 44 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero), 0 UNRUN`. The dispatch-gates slow tier was not run locally (no script is deleted or renamed). It runs on push to main and on the schedule.

## Acceptance notes

- **The reader sits at `scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs`, not under a new `scripts/lib/`.** I wrote it under `scripts/lib/` first. Then `check:pm-dispatch-gates` went red on one case: `promoting 34 module(s) to gate files subtracts no inherited hint from any other family — LOST: scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs … <- scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs (scripts/lib/ci-shard-matrix.mjs)`. A multi-segment import specifier reads as a watch hint, and the modules that import `partition-test-shards.mjs` would lose it. A sibling specifier is the refused single-segment shape, and the case is green with it.
- **Acceptance grep.** `git grep -nE "/(3|8|16)\b" scripts/*.mjs scripts/pm/*.mjs` (ui excluded, see below) has 105 hits outside the reader and `check-expected-skips.mjs`. None of them copies a live ci.yml matrix size. By class:
  - Prose and run citations, e.g. `Test Core (3/3)` in measured-incident comments.
  - Replays of measured runs at the width those runs had, e.g. the dogfood `WORKFLOW_TEXT` for run 38021470264, the six-shard replays, and the `test-N-of-3` synthetic judge fixtures.
  - Synthetic workflows that never read ci.yml (`scripts/pm/ci-failure.mjs` `Fixture shard (… /3)`).
  - CLI file-slice labels (`@objectstack/cli 2/3`), which are not matrix sizes.
  - Unrelated fractions (`options 1/2/3`, `15/16`).
- **Left for other cards.** I edited neither of these:
  - `ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts:54` and `ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts:450-453` (`/16`) belong to `domain:ui`.
  - `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs:316,330,359` belongs to the #26431 roster child.
- **Noted, not changed.**
  - `scripts/ci/select-shard-timings-run.mjs:117` still declares `SHARD_COUNT = 8`. Its header says that value is only its matchers' default (each run is judged at its own `Test Core (N/M)` width). The card's grep does not cover it, and neither does this card's file surface.
  - `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs:4898-4900` spells `Test UI (… /16)` in a synthetic `uiJobFixture`, not a read of ci.yml.
  - ci.yml's own comments (for example "splits the package list into eight") still name the counts. ci.yml is read-only for this card.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (no spec change)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; `pnpm lint` was not run locally, it is a repo-wide scan CI owns)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: in-repo tooling, `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 section is Chinese by the dispatch convention)
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. (local subset per the dispatch gate list; the full lint farm is CI's)
